IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen retry identity for one write, scoped to tenant, subject and operation.

ItemId.description: Stable item identity independent of its current relative path.

ItemStatus.description:
OKF's `status` word of an item, distinct from business approval and from archiving.

An absent OKF `status` reads `stable`. `other` is a producer's value outside the three,
kept exactly as written in the file's `status` property; it cannot be set through
`set_lifecycle`.

oneOf.description: A status word outside the three, preserved in the file.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable application identity for one user-organized workspace.

description:
Change an item's status word or archive flag without claiming a business decision.

At least one of `status` and `archived` is present, and `status` is never `other`
(`check_rules`).

archived.description: Archive (`true`) or unarchive (`false`); absent leaves it unchanged.

base_revision.description: Exact revision on which this change is based; stale writes conflict.

item_id.description: Stable application item identity; paths remain the portable OKF identity.

status.description: New OKF status word; absent leaves it unchanged.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose permissions and storage scope apply.

title: SetLifecycleRequest
